sourceNote: Parent reports only QA harness changes after runtime commit 841fc4a.
method: Opened and visually inspected the four listed original PNGs with Desktop Commander read_file; no browser or test execution by this reviewer.

observations.finding: The Palm Jumeirah and Apartment chips, their remove icons and Clear all fit together on one row. The filter button badge shows 2, and the count/sort row and property card remain visually separated. No clipped chip text or overlapping action was seen.

observations.scope: Lower catalogue dialog; reduce and no-preference
observations.finding: Amenities and listing status remain inside the scrolling body. Header, close button and full footer stay visible; Reset filters and Show properties remain aligned and legible.

resolves.gap: Inline chip/Clear all layout had no dedicated visible frame.
resolves.status: Visually verified at 390px for the two-chip state in both supplied motion modes.

limits: Still-image review does not establish animation timing, focus, URL matching or native Escape behavior.
This closes only the 390px applied-chip visibility gap. The 320/1440 and WebKit final matrix remains separate.
